Name: AUTO_CREATE_ENV_SOUND_PARAM_ST
Description: Ambient one-shot sounds the game places automatically around the player (for example birds or water). At intervals it picks a random point around the player, finds the ground below it, and looks up the row ID = (95000 + EnvPlaceType) × 10000 + (ground material % 100) × 100 + CommonPlaceType. EnvPlaceType is the area's place type (WwiseValueToStrParam_EnvPlaceType row, for example 10 Lake), the ground material is the SE material of the collision or asset hit (for example 5 Grass, 21 Water), and CommonPlaceType is the current common place type. Example: 950002100 = place type 0, Water, common type 0. The row's limits decide whether a sound is created there; the sound played is environment sound (a) with the row ID as its sound ID. No row: nothing is created.

Fields.Name: Spawn Distance - Min
Fields.Description: Nearest horizontal distance in metres from the player at which the sound may be created. A random point closer than this is skipped.

Fields.Name: Spawn Distance - Max
Fields.Description: Farthest horizontal distance in metres from the player at which the sound may be created. A random point farther than this is skipped.

Fields.Name: Lifetime - Min
Fields.Description: Shortest lifetime in seconds. Each sound gets a random lifetime between Min and Max and is stopped when it runs out (or earlier if the sound ends by itself).

Fields.Name: Lifetime - Max
Fields.Description: Longest lifetime in seconds. Each sound gets a random lifetime between Min and Max.

Fields.Name: Delete Distance
Fields.Description: The sound is stopped and removed once the player is this many metres or more away from it.

Fields.Name: Minimum Spacing
Fields.Description: No new sound is created within this many metres of an auto-created sound that is still playing.

Fields.Name: Spawn Angle - Min
Fields.Description: Smallest horizontal angle in degrees, either side of the camera's facing direction, at which the sound may be created. Points at a smaller angle are skipped.

Fields.Name: Spawn Angle - Max
Fields.Description: Largest horizontal angle in degrees, either side of the camera's facing direction, at which the sound may be created. 180: any direction.
